advisory_scope: local dominant reason-code and case-to-code matrix hardening

Aristotle.summary: Recommended explicit primary or priority-selected dominant reason semantics, secondary-code tracking, and matrix rows that distinguish required codes from allowed extras.

Cicero.summary: Recommended concise fields: phase, guard status, dominant reason code, full reason codes, case scope, artifact path, expected/actual status, fail-closed flag, mutation scope, and GMUT gate effect.

Kierkegaard.summary: Reinforced wording boundaries: dominant reason is local rule precedence only, matrix coverage is fixture coverage only, and no connector/cloud/cleanup/GMUT authority is implied.
